entities.summary: Antti Kukkonen was a Finnish Lutheran pastor and politician. He was a member of the Agrarian League. He served as Deputy Minister of Education in Lauri Ingman's second cabinet, as Minister of Education in Juho Sunila's first cabinet, in Kyösti Kallio's third cabinet, in Juho Sunila's second cabinet, in Kyösti Kallio's fourth cabinet, in Risto Ryti's second cabinet and in Jukka Rangell's cabinet as well as a Member of Parliament.
